mistakes.why: agree — это глагол, ему не нужен am. Как «я соглашаюсь», а не «я есть соглашаюсь».

mistakes.right: I really like this film. / I like this film very much.
mistakes.why: very не ставится перед глаголом. Используйте really перед глаголом или very much в конце.

mistakes.right: He told me the truth. / He said the truth to me.
mistakes.why: tell + кому (told me), say + что (said that…). После say нужен to: said to me.
Возраст в английском — через be: I am 25. Have здесь калька с других языков.

mistakes.wrong: Can you explain me this rule?
mistakes.right: Can you explain this rule to me?
mistakes.why: explain sth to sb — объяснять что-то кому-то. Без to нельзя.
bored — мне скучно. boring — я скучный (как человек). То же: interested / interesting, tired / tiring.
information — неисчисляемое: никаких -s и an. Нужно «одна информация» — a piece of information.
depend on — устойчивое сочетание. Никаких from или of.

mistakes.wrong: How is it called in English?
mistakes.right: What is it called in English?
mistakes.why: В английском спрашиваем «Что это называется?» — What, а не How.
Фото в английском «берут»: take a photo / take a picture.

mistakes.wrong: I'll call you when I will arrive.
mistakes.right: I'll call you when I arrive.
mistakes.why: После when, if, as soon as, before, after будущее время передаётся через Present Simple.
It's = It is. «It is depends» — два сказуемых сразу. Достаточно depends.

mistakes.right: I listen to music every day.
mistakes.why: listen to sth — после listen всегда to. Но: I'm listening! (без объекта — без to).
После did / didn't — только первая форма глагола. Прошедшее время уже «живёт» в did.
want sb to do sth — без that.

mistakes.wrong: She is married with a doctor.
mistakes.right: She is married to a doctor.
mistakes.why: married to sb — замужем за кем-то.
good at sth — хорош в чём-то.

mistakes.wrong: I have been in London last year.
mistakes.right: I was in London last year.
mistakes.why: last year — точное время в прошлом → Past Simple.
В вопросах в Present Simple нужен помощник do/does.

mistakes.right: I have been here since Monday.
mistakes.why: since + длительность до сих пор → Present Perfect.
bored — мне скучно; boring — я скучный.

mistakes.wrong: Do you have a pen? — Yes, I do have.
mistakes.right: Yes, I do. / Yes, I have.
mistakes.why: Краткий ответ: Yes, I do. Без повторения have.
home без предлога to: go home, come home.

mistakes.wrong: Can you say me the time?
mistakes.right: Can you tell me the time?
mistakes.why: tell sb sth; say sth (to sb).

mistakes.right: It's absolutely delicious! / It's really tasty!
mistakes.why: delicious уже значит «очень вкусно» — very с ним не ставят.
Действие длится до сих пор → Present Perfect.
discuss без about. Но: talk about it.

mistakes.wrong: I need to make my homework.
mistakes.right: I need to do my homework.
He explained the rule to me.
Everybody is different. / All people are different.
I enjoyed it. / I had fun.
mistakes.why: enjoy требует дополнения: enjoy it, enjoy yourself.

mistakes.wrong: I have a question to you.
mistakes.right: I have a question for you.

mistakes.why: go + -ing без to: go shopping, go swimming.

mistakes.wrong: I'm very hungry, I want to eat something sweety.

mistakes.why: Свет включают: turn on / switch on.
Постоянное место жительства — Present Simple. I'm living — временно.

mistakes.wrong: My dad works like a doctor.
mistakes.right: My dad works as a doctor.
mistakes.why: as — в качестве; like — как будто.

mistakes.wrong: I'll call you when I'll be free.
mistakes.right: I'll call you when I'm free.

mistakes.wrong: We were in the cinema yesterday.
mistakes.right: We went to the cinema yesterday. / We were at the cinema.
mistakes.why: Ходить в кино — go to the cinema; быть в кино — at the cinema.

mistakes.wrong: I'm sorry, I'm late. The traffic was very big.
mistakes.right: The traffic was very heavy / bad.

mistakes.wrong: I made a photo of the sea.
mistakes.right: I took a photo of the sea.
Could I have the menu, please?

mistakes.wrong: I don't know what does it mean.
mistakes.right: I don't know what it means.

mistakes.why: Сильный дождь — heavy rain, rain heavily.

mistakes.wrong: I very want to visit Japan.
mistakes.right: I really want to visit Japan.

mistakes.wrong: Yesterday I have seen a great film.
mistakes.right: Yesterday I saw a great film.
He gave me some advice / a piece of advice.

mistakes.wrong: I go to sleep at 11 o'clock in the night.
mistakes.right: I go to bed at 11 p.m. / at 11 at night.

mistakes.why: Спрашиваем мнение: What do you think?
К другу домой — to my friend's.

mistakes.right: Happy birthday! / Congratulations on your promotion!
mistakes.why: Congratulations on sth. С днём рождения — Happy birthday!
В разделительном вопросе повторяем местоимение: isn't she?

mistakes.wrong: Me and my friend went to the beach.
mistakes.right: My friend and I went to the beach.
mistakes.why: В роли подлежащего — I, и себя называем последним.
Если who — подлежащее, did не нужен.

mistakes.wrong: It's difficult for me speak English.
mistakes.right: It's difficult for me to speak English.
mistakes.why: It's difficult (for sb) to do sth.

mistakes.wrong: The people is very friendly here.
mistakes.right: The people are very friendly here.

mistakes.wrong: I'm used to wake up early.
mistakes.right: I'm used to waking up early.

mistakes.wrong: I'm thinking to buy a car.
mistakes.right: I'm thinking of buying a car.

mistakes.wrong: She has a lot of luggages.
mistakes.right: She has a lot of luggage.

mistakes.wrong: I have a headache since morning.
mistakes.right: I've had a headache since morning.
She suggested that I go. / She suggested going.

mistakes.wrong: I look forward to see you.
mistakes.right: I look forward to seeing you.

mistakes.why: interested — мне интересно; interesting — я интересный.

mistakes.wrong: My English is not so well.
mistakes.right: My English is not very good.
I have a lot of work.

mistakes.why: can сам образует вопрос, do не нужен.

mistakes.wrong: I want to buy new furnitures.
mistakes.right: I want to buy new furniture.

mistakes.wrong: This is the car of my father.
In the photo, I'm in the left.
mistakes.right: In the photo, I'm on the left.
mistakes.why: on the left / on the right.

mistakes.wrong: We have a meeting in Monday.
mistakes.right: We have a meeting on Monday.

mistakes.wrong: I'm reading this book since two weeks.
mistakes.right: I've been reading this book for two weeks.
mistakes.why: Длительность до сих пор: have been + -ing + for.
trousers, jeans, glasses — всегда множественное число.
let sb do sth — без to.
После модальных can, must, should — без to.

mistakes.wrong: How long time does it take?

mistakes.why: Абстрактные понятия в общем смысле — без the.

mistakes.wrong: I go to the work by bike.
mistakes.right: I go to work by bike.

mistakes.why: Искать потерянное — look for. search — обыскивать место.

mistakes.wrong: I came to Vietnam 3 years before.
mistakes.right: I came to Vietnam 3 years ago.
